config.speech_lab.chat_llm_provider_help: Used only for the next chat turn transcribed by Speech Lab. Empty uses the global primary provider.
config.speech_lab.provider_load_failed: The provider list could not be loaded. Save no provider change until the connection is restored.
config.section.speech_lab.label: Speech Lab
config.section.speech_lab.desc: Optional local speech recognition and speech synthesis for telephone and chat.
config.speech_lab.ownership_note: Speech Lab only provides ASR and TTS. Conversation control, the LLM, tools, and memory remain in AuraGo.
config.speech_lab.enabled_help: Allow AuraGo to connect to the local Speech Lab service. Each channel must also be enabled separately.
config.speech_lab.sip_enabled_help: Allow the Telephone agent to select Speech Lab ASR or TTS. Existing calls keep their startup snapshot.
config.speech_lab.chat_input_enabled_hel: Record PCM/WAV in the browser and transcribe it locally. No automatic cloud fallback.
config.speech_lab.chat_output_enabled_he: Synthesize chat responses locally. Text remains available if audio synthesis fails.
config.speech_lab.base_url_help: Fixed Speech Lab API root. Only private or loopback HTTP(S) targets are accepted.
config.speech_lab.advanced_ui_url_help: Optional browser-reachable link to the Speech Lab. Without it, the Lab button stays disabled; activation still works.
config.speech_lab.language_help: Language passed to ASR and TTS.
config.speech_lab.voice_help: Selected exclusively from the active TTS backend catalog.
config.speech_lab.env_managed: Base URL is managed by the AURAGO_SPEECH_LAB_BASE_URL environment variable.
config.speech_lab.save_first: Save the AuraGo configuration before changing the stack.
config.speech_lab.select_stack: Select an available ASR and TTS backend.
config.speech_lab.confirm: Change Speech Lab stack from {old} to {next}? Active operations and calls block this change.
config.speech_lab.apply_failed: Could not activate Speech Lab stack.
